sloka: देवरात इति ख्यातो निमेः ज्येष्ठो मही पतिः ।न्यासो अयम् तस्य भगवन् हस्ते दत्तो महात्मना ॥१-६६-८॥
transliteration: devarāta iti khyāto nimeḥ jyeṣṭho mahī patiḥ ।nyāso ayam tasya bhagavan haste datto mahātmanā ॥1-66-8॥

translations.english: "O Adorable one there was a famous king named Devarata, sixth in line from Nimi. This bow was kept with him in trust by the exalted lord (Shiva).
translations.hindi: शुनःरोप के ऐसे दीन वचन सुन, विश्वामित्र जी ने उसे बहुत कुछ सान्त्वना दी और अपने पुत्रों से बोले
